releases.displayName: [Technical Notice] March 4 Update: Resolution and Progress on Game Login Issues

items.text: Dear Players,

Starting last night (March 3rd), some of you encountered issues logging into the game. Our operations team received your feedback promptly and immediately had our tech staff investigate the problem. We understand this issue has significantly impacted your gaming experience, and we are truly sorry for the inconvenience. We extend our sincerest apologies to every affected player.
I. Core Reason for the Login Issue

Following an emergency investigation, we have determined that the login issue was not caused by a fault in the game program itself. The core reason is that access to specific game-related API services was recently restricted, preventing the login verification process from completing normally. We are aware that many similar games on Steam have encountered the same situation.

[p align="start"]However, we also acknowledge that other comparable products have since completed adaptations to resolve this. Our failure to provide a timely solution for our players is a dereliction of duty on our part. We apologize once again and assure you that our team will continue investigating and working towards a resolution as quickly as possible.
II. Current Solutions Being Implemented

As a priority, we have begun setting up a temporary proxy access channel to restore login access for everyone as swiftly as possible. Please note that this solution may be unstable, and our repair efforts are ongoing.
Our tech staff are currently working 24/7 to implement a stable, permanent fix. Once the solution is confirmed stable, we will announce it through an official notice.

After resolving the immediate login problem, we will proceed to develop and implement a new, long-term stable adaptation solution. This aims to fundamentally address the access restriction issue and prevent similar problems from recurring.
III. Addressing Your Concerns and Seeking Assistance

We fully understand the anxiety and frustration caused by this waiting period. Please rest assured that our development team remains committed to the continuous operation and maintenance of the game, and all related work is progressing steadily.

[p align="start"]We also recognize that our player community is incredibly talented and insightful. If you have any feasible solutions or professional advice regarding this API access restriction issue, please feel free to share them in the comments section or via private message. You can also contact us directly at:
· Email: 3974722923@qq.com
IV. Follow-up Progress Updates

We will provide timely updates on any progress regarding this issue. The latest information will be posted on the Steam Announcement board and our official XiaoHeiHe account, ensuring every player can stay informed.

[p align="start"]Once again, we apologize for the poor experience caused by this incident. We are deeply grateful for your patience, understanding, and support. We will do our utmost to restore a stable gaming experience for everyone as soon as possible.
Sincerely,
The Operations & Technical Team of Revenge On Gold Diggers
March 4, 2026
Dear Players,
Thank you all for your continued support and interest in Revenge on Gold Diggers.
This update includes targeted optimizations based on player feedback regarding the 4K DLC, with the goal of improving the overall gameplay experience.
Update Time: December 29, 2025, 1:15 AM (PST)
During the update, normal gameplay will not be affected. Only players who have installed the DLC The Not-Quite-Fully 4K Edition are required to download this update.
The update patch size is approximately 2 GB. Please make sure you have sufficient free disk space before updating (the space does not need to be on the same drive as the base game).
Update Details：
【Feature Optimization】

Fixed an issue where certain content did not play correctly when using Master Mode after installing the DLC The Not-Quite-Fully 4K Edition.If the game fails to run properly, you can right-click on the game in the \, select \ - \[Installed Files] - \[Verify integrity of game files] to repair the game files

We hope this update helps improve your experience with the game. We truly value and welcome your continued feedback and suggestions. Every message you share with us is carefully read and greatly appreciated.
